note: Authenticity intents (IMAGE_VERIFICATION, VIDEO_VERIFICATION, MEDIA_AUTHENTICITY_CHECK, CONTENT_VERIFICATION). The answer is a verdict about whether something is genuine, so the failure mode is a wrong answer that shares almost every word with the right one. Several cases turn on one flipped word, and two deliberately carry two verdicts at once (real image, fabricated caption) because a single polarity table reads those as self-contradictions.

cases.question: Was this image produced by a generative model?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, it was generated by a diffusion model.
cases.good: Synthetic, the output of a generative model.
cases.bad: No, it is a genuine photograph.

cases.question: Which tool generated this image?
cases.bad: It is a camera original, no tool involved.

cases.question: How confident is the synthetic-image verdict?
Has the face in this video been swapped?
cases.bad: No, there is no sign of a face swap.

cases.question: Are there splice artifacts at frame 240?
Was the voice in this clip synthesised?
Does this image carry a valid C2PA provenance manifest?
cases.ground_truth: No, the provenance manifest is missing.

cases.question: Is the photograph real but the caption fabricated?
cases.ground_truth: The image is authentic, the caption is false.
cases.bad: Fake photo with an accurate caption.

cases.question: Has this document been altered since it was signed?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, it was modified after signing.
cases.good: Modified after the signature was applied.
cases.bad: No, it is unaltered since signing.

cases.question: Is this text original or copied from another source?
cases.bad: It was plagiarised from another source.

cases.question: Does the file hash match the published checksum?
Is the quote accurate but attributed to the wrong person?
cases.ground_truth: The quote is accurate, the attribution is wrong.
